# Tabler Icons

Source: https://github.com/tabler/tabler-icons
Revision: `a4ce1404bc6d24d3c365afe7b258d6bf6f48d62d`

Selected outline SVGs are vendored unmodified. MIT license: see LICENSE.
The application sets display size, stroke width 1 and currentColor when rendering.

(https://raw.githubusercontent.com/tabler/tabler-icons/main/icons/outline/scissors.svg), same MIT license.

(https://raw.githubusercontent.com/tabler/tabler-icons/main/icons/outline/file-lock.svg), same MIT license.
